scope: Curated GH1 candidates, not a complete or official inventory. Third-party category listings are dated 2022–2023; names and metadata need SDK confirmation. Null = unknown; never infer defaults or GUIDs. Status reflects baseline NODES code, not a comparison run.

gh2.reason: Rhino 9 beta, evolving SDK and different data model. Do not import GH1 rows into GH2.

components.name: Number Slider
components.limitation: Numeric controls; GH slider modes and rounding not compared

components.name: Graph Mapper
components.limitation: Profile-specific radius interpolation, not a general graph mapper

components.name: Addition
components.limitation: Numeric only; GH overloads and matching not compared

components.name: Division
components.limitation: Zero and tolerance semantics not compared

components.name: Flatten Tree
components.limitation: NODES flattens into path [0]; GH fixture needed

components.name: Graft Tree
components.limitation: Mixed-depth empty collision regression added; GH fixture needed

components.name: Path Mapper
components.limitation: No path expression parser on baseline

components.name: Tree Branch
components.limitation: No path value or branch selection

components.name: Merge
components.limitation: Two inputs only; mesh merge is NOT this operation

components.name: List Item
components.limitation: Indices and wrap supported; tree matching not verified

components.name: Sort List
components.limitation: Numeric keys only; no paired lists

components.name: Series
components.limitation: Count limited; GH results not compared

components.name: Range
components.limitation: Count means points; GH interval/steps semantics differ

components.name: Deconstruct
components.limitation: One selected axis rather than three output ports

components.name: Circle
components.limitation: Sampled XY polyline; no analytic circle

components.name: Polygon
components.limitation: XY only; plane and corner options not matched

components.name: Divide Curve
components.limitation: No arc-length division or tangent/parameter outputs

components.name: Extrude
components.limitation: Closed planar polyline, positive Z only

components.name: Sweep1
components.limitation: No rail sweep or surface type

components.name: Sweep2
components.limitation: No rail sweep or surface type

components.name: Volume
components.limitation: Mesh volume helper is not a GH-equivalent node

components.name: Weld Mesh
components.limitation: Export weld is not a node

components.name: Solid Union
components.limitation: No B-rep boolean; mesh merge is not union

components.name: Move
components.limitation: Numeric XYZ offsets, not vector port

components.name: Custom Preview
components.limitation: No material/colour value or preview node
